name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
description: Measures red blood cells, white blood cells and platelets.

name: Blood Glucose Test
description: Measures the level of glucose in your blood.

name: Renal Function Test
description: Checks kidney function through blood markers.

name: HbA1c Test
description: Measures average blood sugar over recent months.

name: Vitamin D Test
description: Measures vitamin D levels in your blood.
